title: REST API
description: A schema representing the key properties and constraints of a RESTful API following the Representational State Transfer architectural style.

name.description: The name of the REST API.

description.description: A description of the API's purpose and capabilities.

baseUrl.description: The base URL of the API server.

resources.description: The resources exposed by the API.

authentication.description: Authentication scheme used by the API.

formats.description: Content formats supported by the API.

Resource.description: A named information resource identified by a URI path.

path.description: The URI path pattern (may include {parameter} templates).

methods.description: HTTP methods supported by this resource.
